english: The following continuous frequency distribution, in which $f$ is a positive integer, has arithmetic mean $28.5$ (computed with the class marks).
Then the mean deviation about the mean of this distribution is ______.
hindi: निम्न सतत बारंबारता बंटन, जिसमें $f$ एक धनात्मक पूर्णांक है, का समान्तर माध्य (वर्ग चिह्नों से परिकलित) $28.5$ है।
तब इस बंटन का माध्य के सापेक्ष माध्य विचलन ______ है।
solution_full: Absolute deviations of the class marks from $28.5$: $23.5,13.5,3.5,6.5,16.5$.
originality_note: New: the mean, given only to fix the missing frequency, is then the centre of the mean deviation, and the mean falls between class marks so every deviation is a half-integer (way 5 within one concept). Closest known: textbook grouped mean deviation tables. Different because: the table is incomplete and must be completed from the mean first.
stem_review: Read as a student: every observation, class, symbol and condition is introduced before use, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed independently in Python (exact fractions / sympy), is unique and equals the Answer Plan. Changed: No change.
key_step: Recovering f from the mean, then the weighted absolute deviations.

concept_use.Mean deviation of a continuous frequency: MD = sum f|m - 28.5| / N = 210/20 after completing the table.

blueprint_concepts: Mean deviation of a continuous frequency distribution
